[[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.1 (Tick) |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is a unit spawned by the [[Necromancer]]'s Level 3 gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It is a high health unit which has a strong attack. When enemies are within range, the '''Executioner Skeleton''' will stop moving to throw its axe, which will travel in a straight line. When in flight, the axe deals 100 damage every 0.1 seconds to any enemy caught in it, which can deal hundreds of damage to multiple enemies if the trajectory is right. This makes it quite powerful on certain maps with paths that facilitate the ability. Once the axe returns and no other enemies are in range, the '''Executioner Skeleton''' will continue moving. Overall, the unit's high health and strong attack make it quite powerful. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, brown torn cape, grey crown and shoulder-pads, and grey knee-pads, armbands and chestplate, which have a black skull with blue glowing eyes. It wields a large black axe with a black skull which has blue eyes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaExecutionerSkeleton.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' has a high amount of health, making it useful against hordes of enemies, like the [[Molten]], [[Fallen]] or [[Monkey]]. **It can also be quite useful at killing or weakening higher health enemies, such as the [[Fallen Giant]] or [[Molten Titan]]. **The '''Executioner Skeleton''', despite its high health, should not be used exclusively for its collision damage, as its ranged attack is also quite powerful. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' will throw its axe at an enemy, quickly dealing high damage to enemies hit by it. **However, do note that the axe always travels a specific distance in a straight line. This means that in some situations it could go through a line full of enemies, while in others it could hit just a few enemies, making it quite inconsistent. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Bulwark]] or [[Fallen Jester]]. *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' can cope well against enemies that deal damage to units with their abilities due to its high health. **However, it will be completely destroyed if the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] performs its ''Void Stomp'' attack. ==Trivia== *The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is based on the [[Executioner]] tower, however the axe flight path is a lot more similar to the [[Executioner (Lunar Overture)|Executioner]] enemy and [[Jaxe (Solar Eclipse)|Jaxe]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
